risk_notes.text: Spot BTC ETF flows (IBIT/FBTC vs GBTC) are the marginal BTC price driver since Jan-2024 launch; GBTC's post-conversion outflows offset peer inflows through much of 2024.
BTC treasury companies (MSTR et al.) trade at premiums/discounts to NAV that expand and compress with BTC momentum — premium issuance funds further BTC accumulation (reflexive).
GENIUS Act signed Jul-2025 — first US federal stablecoin law (reserve + licensing regime); structural tailwind for USDC/PYUSD vs offshore USDT.

Notable crypto-adjacent M&A owned by parents in other universes: CoreWeave→Core Scientific ~$9B (Jul-2025, acquirer in ai_buildout); Stripe→Bridge $1.1B (technology universe); Visa→Plaid $5.3B terminated on DOJ block (technology universe).
Apr-2024 halving cut block rewards to 3.125 BTC; miners pivoting to AI/HPC hosting (Hut 8, Core Scientific, Bitfarms) to diversify from pure hashprice exposure.
